stemMd: A café sold 28 drinks: tea at 2 euros and coffee at 3 euros. Revenue was 71 euros. How many coffees were sold?
explanationMd: If c coffees were sold, tea sales were $28-c$. Revenue gives $3c+2(28-c)=71$, hence $c=15$. The remaining 13 teas give $45+26=71$.

distractorRationale.c: Divides approximate revenue by an average price without imposing the count.
distractorRationale.d: Treats almost all drinks as coffees and violates revenue.
